note: maib's tariffs and commissions for card servicing (last revision in force from 1 October 2026, at a new address; read 2026-11-03 from Common Crawl's capture of it of 6 October 2026, since the bank's server answers curl with a bot check; the revision in force from 30 June 2026, read 2026-10-29 through the fetch tool, gave the same figures): the maib daily general card account carries a monthly administration fee of 15 lei, nothing in a month with at least 3,000 lei of cashless payments, a condition the game doesn't track, so it's charged in full.
